attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: business_rule_extraction_from_process_document
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_pipeline
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "pipeline_service"
      description: "Authenticate the upload pipeline service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_fetch_document
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/knowledge-base/uploaded-document"
      timeout: 300
    output: raw_document

  - id: step_validate_document
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_document
      schema: process_document_schema
    output: validated_document

  - id: step_extract_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_document
      field: "document_text"
    output: document_text

  - id: step_call_llm_extract_rules
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: document_text
      url: "/langgraph/extract-business-rules"
      method: "POST"
      timeout: 300
      description: "Call LLM via LangGraph to identify and extract individual business rules"
    output: raw_extracted_rules

  - id: step_validate_extracted_rules
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_extracted_rules
      schema: extracted_business_rules_schema
      description: "Validate the structure of each extracted rule"
    output: validated_rules

  - id: step_transform_rules_with_status
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_rules
      mapping:
        status: "pending_review"
        searchable: false
      description: "Set each rule status to pending_review and mark as not searchable"
    output: rules_with_status

  - id: step_handle_store_errors
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: step_terminate_on_failure
      scope: "step_store_rules"

  - id: step_store_rules
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      step: step_write_single_rule
    output: stored_rules

  - id: step_write_single_rule
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      table: "business_rules"
      description: "Store each rule individually with status pending_review"
    output: write_rules_result

  - id: step_generate_embeddings
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: rules_with_status
      url: "/api/embeddings/generate"
      method: "POST"
      config:
        dimensions: 4096
      timeout: 300
      description: "Generate 4096-dimension embeddings for each extracted rule"
    output: raw_embeddings

  - id: step_validate_embeddings
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_embeddings
      schema: embeddings_schema
      config:
        expected_dimensions: 4096
    output: validated_embeddings

  - id: step_merge_rules_embeddings
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_embeddings
      secondary: stored_rules
      join_key: "rule_id"
      description: "Link embeddings to their corresponding rules"
    output: rules_with_embeddings

  - id: step_store_embeddings
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: rules_with_embeddings
      table: "rule_embeddings_pgvector"
      config:
        dimensions: 4096
        engine: "pgvector"
      description: "Store embeddings in pgvector linked to each rule"
    output: write_embeddings_result

  - id: step_log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: write_embeddings_result
      event: "business_rules_extracted"
      details: "Business rules extracted from process document and stored for review"
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: step_notify_validators
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: write_rules_result
      recipient: "validator_group"
      message: "New business rules have been extracted and are pending review."
      channel: "email"
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Business rule extraction pipeline completed successfully"

  - id: step_terminate_on_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      message: "Business rule extraction pipeline failed during processing"
